summary: iter-216 (v62.1 PAMM Strategy Foundation) HTTP end-to-end verification. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter216_pamm_strategy_http.py — 29 HTTP tests, all pass in 7.0s. Coverage: (1) GET /api/pamm/strategies returns 4 strategies {sniper, scalper, fast_scalp, nitro_scalper} each with version=1.0.0, 32-char strategy_hash, unique magic codes in (62000..62100), genuinely distinct characteristics AND gate sets (4/4 unique), feature_flags exactly {PAMM_STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT:true, PAMM_MULTI_STRATEGY:false, PAMM_DYNAMIC_AI:false, PAMM_NITRO_LIVE:false}, risk_profiles = {conservative,controlled,growth}; plain non-manager → 403. (2) GET /strategies/nitro-eligibility returns {score, 8 components (latency_quality, infrastructure_health, spread_quality, broker_quality, slippage_quality, liquidity, market_quality, regime_compatibility), status ∈ {NITRO_ENABLED, NITRO_REDUCED, NITRO_PAUSED}, thresholds{enabled_min, reduced_min, hard_floor}}; BOLA: non-admin manager passing another user's account_id → 404. (3) GET /programs/{id}/strategy on fresh program → {mode:'LEGACY', assignment:null} (migration safety). (4) POST /strategy SINGLE sniper controlled → pinned strategy_version+strategy_hash, status ASSIGNED, certification_status UNCERTIFIED; second POST → 409 assignment_exists; strategy_id:'bogus' → 400 strategy_not_eligible; risk_profile_id:'bogus' → 400 unknown_risk_profile; mode:'MULTI' → 400 mode_not_enabled. (5) POST /strategy/validate for sniper → {passed:true, checks with keys strategy_registered/pamm_eligible/version_pin/risk_profile}; for nitro_scalper → additionally includes execution_eligibility check carrying {score, status}. (6) POST /strategy/activate — the REAL step-up gate returns 403 (mfa_enrollment_required for admin without 2FA); with X-Step-Up-Bypass (server secret) activation of sniper succeeds → status ACTIVE, and activation of nitro_scalper is REJECTED 403 nitro_live_disabled (PAMM_NITRO_LIVE off). (7) PATCH /strategy {risk_profile_id:'growth', target_weight:0.8} → updated + version bumped to ≥2; unknown profile → 400. (8) POST /strategy/suspend on ASSIGNED (not ACTIVE) → 409 no_active_assignment. (9) POST /strategy/change with seeded OPEN trade on master_account_id → 409 program_not_flat (open_positions≥1); after removing the trade → 200, old assignment REPLACED, new one created. (10) GET /api/pamm/events?program_id= after assign+validate contains both PAMM_STRATEGY_ASSIGNED and PAMM_STRATEGY_VALIDATED. (11) BOLA: plain non-manager user on GET/POST/activate on program_a → 403/404. Unknown program_id → 404. Offline suite: tests/test_iter216_pamm_strategy.py → 20 passed; env -u MONGO_URL -u DB_NAME -u REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL python -m pytest -m unit -q → 1615 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed. Cleanup verified: 0 iter216 users/programs/trades/events/assignments; demo program pgm_c270193fed has 0 assignments (LEGACY as found).
action_items: Note: the review request stated 'offline test file → 22 passed' but tests/test_iter216_pamm_strategy.py currently has 20 test functions (all pass). Not a bug; verify whether 2 additional cases were intended (magic-namespace/version_hash boundary etc).
critical_code_review_comments: strategy_assignment.assign() correctly checks PAMM_STRATEGY_ASSIGNMENT / mode gating; MULTI/DYNAMIC_AI collapse to 400 mode_not_enabled — verified end-to-end.

The uniq_active_per_program partial index on {pamm_program_id} where status=ACTIVE is created lazily via ensure_indexes() called on every assign(); reads on get_assignment() correctly return the newest ASSIGNED/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED (sort created_at desc). The API-level pre-check in assign() (find_one status∈{ASSIGNED,ACTIVE}) is what actually returns the friendly 409 assignment_exists — good UX layer above the DB unique index.

activate() explicitly gates PAMM_NITRO_LIVE for strategy_id='nitro_scalper' AFTER version-pin check → the route maps this to HTTP 403 nitro_live_disabled while all other business errors map to 409. This matches spec (Nitro assignable+validatable but not activatable in v62.1).

change() correctly calls _open_positions() which uses master_account_id when present (falls back to program_id filter otherwise); the flat-guard 409 program_not_flat returns open_positions count for observability — verified with a seeded open trade.
require_program_access() rejects non-admin non-manager on ALL /strategy* endpoints BEFORE any DB mutation (BOLA-safe).
nitro-eligibility BOLA: non-admin manager tries to read another user's account → 404 (parse_object_id + user_id scope filter) — cannot enumerate or infer existence.

Suggestion (non-blocking): patch() does not zero-out last_validation when risk_profile_id or weights change — an active assignment can therefore stay ACTIVE after a risk profile bump without re-validation. Consider forcing a re-validate step (status→ASSIGNED or last_validation.passed=False) on any patch that changes risk envelope. Not a bug in v62.1 spec but worth thinking about for v62.2.

Suggestion (non-blocking): the /strategies endpoint returns feature_flags at the top level AND per-strategy 'requires_latency_certification' flag. Consider surfacing an explicit boolean per-strategy 'live_activation_allowed' that composes the flag with the strategy id, so the UI doesn't need to hardcode the 'nitro_scalper + PAMM_NITRO_LIVE' rule.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter216_pamm_strategy_http.py is the canonical HTTP regression for v62.1 PAMM strategy profiles. Key gotchas: (1) conftest.py auto-injects X-Step-Up-Bypass and X-CSRF-Token on every requests call — to exercise the REAL step-up gate, set session.headers['X-Step-Up-Bypass'] = '' before the call and restore after (see test_activate_requires_step_up_without_bypass). (2) Program creation uses SANDBOX_PARTNER_ID (prt_sandbox) which auto-provisions a broker program — safe and cheap. (3) When creating a program used for /strategy/change tests you must manually inject master_account_id in Mongo so _open_positions() has an account to filter on; otherwise it falls back to program_id filtering and the flat-guard fires on program_id-matched trades. (4) POST /api/pamm/programs is admin-only; managers cannot self-create programs. (5) Feature flag defaults at import time from os.environ — no restart needed if you flip an env var and restart supervisor (which pytest doesn't do).
